en: Outside, take a tutor's teaching.
At home, follow the mother's model.
The aunts and uncles of the clan.

meaning: 把侄子看作自己的儿子。
en: Treat nephews as your own sons.
Hold brothers close in heart.
One breath, branches of a single tree.
Choose friends of matching spirit.
Polish and admonish each other.
Kindness and quiet compassion.

meaning: 匆忙仓促之时也不背离。
en: Never abandon it even in haste.
Integrity, righteousness, purity, modesty.
Do not lose it in adversity.
Quiet nature, easy feelings.
A restless mind tires the spirit.
Keep the true self, and the will is full.
Chasing things, the will drifts.
Hold fast to noble conduct.

meaning: 好的爵位自来系在身上。
en: Good rank binds itself to you.
The capitals of Huaxia.
The two capitals, east and west.
Back to Mount Mang, facing the Luo.
Float on the Wei, hold the Jing.
Palaces coil and rise.
Towers soar, startling the eye.
Paint birds and beasts.
Color the immortal spirits.
Side chambers open beside them.
Curtained tents face the pillars.
Mats and seats are laid out.
Zithers are plucked and pipes blown.
Climb the steps to the throne.
Caps turn like stars.
Right leads to the Guangnei hall.
Left reaches the Chengming hall.
The ancient books are gathered.
And the finest talents gather too.

meaning: 杜度的草稿，钟繇的隶书。
en: Du Du's draft script, Zhong You's clerical hand.

meaning: 漆写的经书，壁藏的典籍。
en: Lacquer-written books and wall-hidden classics.
Generals and ministers line the court.
Dukes and ministers flank the road.
Households enfeoffed with eight counties.
Each house supplies a thousand troops.
Tall-capped men attend the carriage.
Drive on with tassels flying.
Hereditary stipends and lavish wealth.
Fat horses and light carriages.
Merit recorded, rich and real.
Steles are carved with inscriptions.
Jiang Ziya at Pan Creek, and Yi Yin.
Aiding the age as chief minister.
Taking Qufu as their seat.
Without the Duke of Zhou, who could build it?

meaning: 齐桓公匡正天下，合诸侯。
en: Duke Huan of Qi rectified and united the states.
Aid the weak, hold up the falling.
Qili Ji changed Emperor Hui's mind.
Fu Yue moved King Wu Ding.
The worthy labor diligently.
Many worthy officers bring true peace.
Jin and Chu took turns as hegemon.
Zhao and Wei were trapped by the horizontal alliance.
Borrowing a road through Yu, Guo was destroyed.

meaning: 在践土会合诸侯，订立盟约。
en: The covenant sworn at Jiantu.
Xiao He kept the law simple.
Han Fei fell to harsh punishment.
Bai Qi, Wang Jian, Lian Po and Li Mu.
The most skilled in war.
Might proclaimed across the desert.
Fame spreads through painting.
Nine provinces bear Yu's traces.
A hundred commanderies joined by Qin.
Of the five peaks, Tai is chief.

meaning: 封禅之礼，以云云亭亭为主。
en: The sacrifice centers on Yun and Ting.
Yanmen Pass and the Purple Frontier.
Jitian and Chicheng.
Kunming Pool and Jieshi.
Juye Marsh and Dongting Lake.
Vast, remote and far-stretching.
Crags and caves, deep and dim.
Farming is the root of governing.
Attend to sowing and harvesting.

meaning: 开始到南边的田里耕作。
en: Begin work in the southern fields.
I plant millet and grain.
Tax the ripe grain, offer the new.
Reward or dismiss each as deserved.
